system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.

## Question 1

A. Draw 1 straight line on this rectangle to divide it into 2 triangles.

## Question 3

C. Draw 2 straight lines on this rectangle to divide it into 1 rectangle and 2 triangles.

Answer each of the 3 questions.

output.answer_1: I would draw a straight line from the top left corner of the rectangle to the bottom right corner. This line would cut diagonally across the rectangle, creating two triangles.
output.answer_2: I would draw a straight vertical line down the middle of the rectangle, dividing it into two equal rectangles. The line would be perpendicular to the top and bottom sides.
output.answer_3: I would draw a horizontal line across the rectangle, about a third of the way down from the top. Then, I would draw a vertical line from the left side of the rectangle to intersect this horizontal line. This would create one rectangle at the bottom right and two triangles – one in the top left and one on the left side.
